about.contentEn:
## Our Story

Mealnova began in Pune in 2009 with one kitchen, a simple promise, and a focus on pure vegetarian food made with consistency. What started as a home-style meal operation for nearby offices has grown into a catering business serving corporate cafeterias, hostels, and large-format events across Pune.

## What We Do

We handle menu planning, preparation, billing, and service operations as your single dependable partner — from daily office lunches to weddings and conferences.

## Why Mealnova

Pure vegetarian kitchens, menus built around repeatability and dietary needs, flexible service for corporates and hostels, and reliability across quality, dispatch, and meal timing.

privacy-policy.contentEn:
## Privacy Policy

Mealnova respects your privacy. We collect only the information you provide when you request a quote, place an order, or contact us — such as your name, company, email, and phone number. We use it to respond to enquiries, provide catering services, and issue invoices. We do not sell your personal data.

## Contact

For questions about this policy, email hello@mealnova.com or call +91-7733727832.

terms-of-service.contentEn:
## Terms of Service

These terms govern your use of Mealnova's website and catering services. Orders, quotes, and meal programs are subject to confirmation and availability. Pricing, GST, and service scope are set out in your proposal or invoice. By using this site you agree to these terms.

## Contact

For questions about this policy, email hello@mealnova.com or call +91-7733727832.

refund-policy.contentEn:
## Refund Policy

Refunds and cancellations for catering orders are handled per the terms in your proposal or invoice. For recurring corporate meal programs, cancellations must be notified in advance as agreed in your contract. Contact us promptly for any billing or service concern and we'll make it right.

## Contact

For questions about this policy, email hello@mealnova.com or call +91-7733727832.
